name: blind-dx-study
description: Run a blind developer-experience usability study: fan out fresh-eyes subject agents that only see what a real first-time user would (published packages, findable docs, --help), never the source tree, capture ranked friction findings against an "incredibly easy" bar, independently reproduce every functional claim before weighting it, and synthesize a convergence verdict across cohorts and waves. Pairs with an eng fleet to close the measure-fix-remeasure loop.
